entries.title: [1] Moves that conflict with the personality
entries.text: Like Baby-Doll Eyes, Charm, Fake Tears, Flattery, Growl, Kinesis, Scary Face, Tail Whip, Tearful Look, Tickle.

entries.title: [2] Moves that kiss another character without consent or  cause infatuation
entries.text: Like Attract, Captivate, Lovely Kiss, Draining Kiss, Sweet Kiss

entries.title: [3] Moves that are the signature of a legendary
entries.text:
All Legendary Pokemon have exclusive moves, with some being the moves of another form or regional variant, and some being custom made for the server.

In some cases, a legendary move might now be widely avaliable for non-legendary characters (For example, sacred sword, the ex-signature move Cobalion) In those cases, you can use them normaly and instead we will either find a substitute or create a custom new signature move.

entries.title: [4] Abilities that force a character to feel a certain way
[1] Changes to Legendary Signatures
entries.text:
- **Oblivion Wing:** The user can choose if they want it to be Dark or Flying

- **Ruination:** Accuracy reduced from 100% to 70%

- **Nature’s Madness:** Accuracy reduced from 100% to 70% and is single target

entries.title: [2] Important changes to other Moves
entries.text:
Copycat, Sketch, Metronome: Cannot copy or call upon another legendary’s signature move. Additionally, if a move you copy is not one of your types, it will be at reduced power

Sketch: You can only have one instance of Sketch. Once you use it once in a RP and it will reverted to sketch once the RP has finished.

entries.title: [3] Legendary Moves Substitution
entries.text:
- **Articuno - Freezing Glare:** From the Galarian Articuno. The player chooses if move is Ice or Psychic Type
- **Zapdos - Thunderous Kick:**  From the Galarian Zapdos. The player chooses if move is Electric or Fighting type
- **Moltres - Fiery Wrath:**  From the Galarian Moltres. The player chooses if move is Fire or Dark
- **Mew - Genesis Supernova:** Mew's Z move in Sol and Moon. Has been reassigned as Mew's Signature with 5PP
- **Entei - Burning Bulwark:** From the Paradox Entei
- **Raikou - Thunderclap:** From the Paradox Raikou
- **Suicune - Hydro Stream:** From the Paradox Suicune
- **Celebi - Light of Ruin:** AZ's Floette Signature Move. Has been reasigned to Celebi.
- **Uxie, Mesprit, Azelf - Mystical Power:** The three of them have the same signature move.
- **Cresselia - Lunar Dance & Lunar Blessing:** You can choose to use one or both
- **Manaphy - Heart Swap & Take Heart:** You can choose one or both
- **Victini - Searing Shot & V-Create:** You can choose one or both
- **Cobalion - Trachyon Cutter:** From Iron Crown.
- **Terrakion - Mighty Cleave:** From Iron Boulder
- **Virizion - Psyblade:** From Iron Leaves
- **Reshiram - Fusion Flare & Blue Flare:** You can choose one or both
- **Zekrom - Fusion Bolt & Bolt Strike:** You can choose one or both
- **Yvetal - Oblivion Wing** The player can choose if they want to make it a dark or flying type.

entries.title: [4] Character Relocation
entries.text: - Paradox Pokémon are considered to be simply regional variants from an unknown region.
